name: agent-board
description: Painel local do Tech Lead: acompanha o time, a fila, reviews, PRs e sessões de agentes de IA

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:hooks && npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:hooks: node --test test/hook.test.js test/launch.test.js test/state.test.js test/usage.test.js ci/ai-review.test.mjs
